'''Kevin Brownell''' (forum handle '''CubsFan''') served as an advocate of the [[Players Committee]] for marketing and player relations.

He accepted an invitation to become the Marketing &amp; Player Relations Player Advocate in 2004. His role was to keep the community up to date on events and game news, on the official site and on other CCG websites. He also acted as a liaison between the PC and the playing community. He was also named a member of the PC's &ldquo;WebGroup&rdquo;, formed at the same time to coordinate the PC website. He was an attorney in Chicago and had played since the first Premiere starter decks.<ref name="newadv2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603214022/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/NewAdvocates.htm New Advocates! Not 1 but 2!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref> The 2005 and 2006 council pages list him there as Player Relations and Marketing Advocate.<ref name="council2005">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050829220138/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 29 August 2005)</ref><ref name="advocates2006">[https://web.archive.org/web/20060617221233/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Content&pa=showpage&pid=3 Advocates], swccgpc.com Content pid=3 (published 1 May 2006; Wayback, 17 June 2006)</ref>

In May 2004, when Decipher began clearing its ratings database, he moved his rating to the new database, noting that a large part of the community no longer ran Decipher-sanctioned tournaments, mostly because of the payment and credit-card requirements.<ref name="pcf-3296-46226">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46226#46226 Ratings - see PC announcement], Kevin Brownell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625214243/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46459%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He planned to help at Gen Con 2004 and to play in the tournament there,<ref name="pcf-3538-48373">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48373#48373 Gen-Con Leadership?], Kevin Brownell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021307/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48392%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and before the [[2004 World Championship]] he answered players' questions, confirming that the Day 1 heats were Open, not Classic, and that Heat 2 would start when Heat 1 ended.<ref name="pcf-3797-52476">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52476#52476 Day 1], Kevin Brownell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041105141844/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52779%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-3797-52776">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52776#52776 Day 1], Kevin Brownell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041105141844/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52779%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> After Worlds 2004 he recommended [[Lee Edwards]] for the PC's Playtest Committee.<ref name="pcf-4063-55375">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55375#55375 State of the PC Address: So long and thanks for all the fish], Lee Edwards, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050228234323/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55374%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 11 October 2004 he announced that the [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds|Virtual Set 6]] and [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire|Virtual Set 7]] files on swccgpc.com had been redone with the current, post-errata texts.<ref name="pcf-4041-55058">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55058#55058 V-set 6 and 7 redone!], Kevin Brownell (CubsFan), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 October 2004). == Card credits ==
Kevin Brownell is credited with the original concept of four Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: [[2004 Illinois State Championship|Illinois States 2004]]. The cards are in [[Virtual Block 4]] (cards first released 2002–2009) and [[Virtual Set 0]] (released 24 September 2014).
